title: Jim Harbaugh: Trey Lance and DJ Uiagalelei are in a tight race for backup QB

sources.title: Jim Harbaugh: Trey Lance and DJ Uiagalelei are in a tight race for backup QB
sources.description: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh remains undecided about who quarterback Justin Herbert's backup will be when the regular season starts.
